title: Visiting the library garden
passage: The library garden opens at noon Saturday. Tables without cards are open to anyone; a card reserves a table for reading-group members. The garden gate unlocks only from the street. Normally, exit through the lobby. It closes at four; until the garden closes at five, the caretaker lets you out through the service yard. After reading an indoor display book outside, leave it on the blue cart; these returns guide next month's display.
passageZh: 圖書館庭園星期六中午開放。沒放卡片的桌子誰都可以使用；有卡片的桌子保留給讀書會會員。庭園大門只能從街道側解鎖。平常請從大廳離開。大廳四點關閉；到庭園五點關閉前，管理員會讓你從後勤院區離開。從室內展示架取出的書，在戶外讀完後請放在藍色推車上；這些歸還的書會作為下個月展示的參考。
